## About
We're a used auto parts yard on Bruce Garner Rd in Wake Forest. We carry parts for foreign and domestic cars, trucks and SUV's.
Search our inventory online before you drive out. One reviewer found hard to find parts for an old Mitsubishi here, and another got a transmission for a Dodge Dakota that Lindsey delivered to his shop herself.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used parts for the Wake Forest area.
- Search Inventory: Look up what's in the yard online before you make the drive.
- Multi-Part Search: Search for multiple parts on our site.

## FAQ
Q: What vehicles do you carry parts for?
A: Foreign and domestic cars, trucks and SUV's.

Q: Do your parts have a warranty?
A: Yes. We offer a 60-day warranty.

- "Nine's Auto Parts provided excellent support in all regards. Lindsey and Jamie visually verified that the transmission I wanted was still available. They scheduled delivery on the first available timeslot to my preferred automotive shop (Murray's Tries and Auto Service). Lindsey delivered the transmission herself and ensured it was available within 15 minutes of my truck being dropped off for servicing. GREAT EXPERIENCE by a GREAT TEAM!!!" (Thomas Purdy, 5/5)
